owner.title: Contact
owner.remarks: The contact person for this service group. You create contacts in the People application.

commodity.title: Commodity Group
commodity.remarks: The unique value for the commodity group that is used to classify items and services.

parent.title: Parent
parent.remarks: Identifies the parent commodity that is associated with the current record.

description.title: Description
description.remarks: Names or describes the commodity group that is used to classify items and services.

ownergroup.title: Contact Group
ownergroup.remarks: The group of contact people for this service group. You create contact groups in the Person Groups application.

servicetype.title: Type
servicetype.remarks: You can select the type of service. The service types are Procure, Provide, or Both.

commoditiesid.title: Commodity ID
commoditiesid.remarks: The unique identifier of the commodity.

isservice.title: Service
isservice.remarks: Indicates whether the commodity can be used by a service type item and service level agreements (SLA).
